title: 光學散射量測
summary: 從週期標靶、偏振和角度到製程回授：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Periodic targets and Polarization and angle to Process feedback: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: 週期標靶：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「散射反演需要明確幾何參數化」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Scatter inversion needs explicit geometry parameterization.
steps.instruction:
畫光柵節距、線寬、高度與側壁角的參數圖。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設對稱梯形線條高 100 nm、頂寬 40 nm、底寬 60 nm，每側水平差為 (60−40)/2=10 nm。相對水平面的側壁角 atan(100/10)≈84.29°；相對垂直面的傾斜約 5.71°。這是已知幾何的計算，不能證明光學反演已唯一決定此形貌。
steps.instructionEn:
Parameterize grating pitch, width, height and sidewall angle. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a symmetric trapezoidal line 100 nm high, 40 nm wide at top and 60 nm at bottom. Each side shifts horizontally by 10 nm. Sidewall angle from horizontal is atan(100/10)≈84.29°, or 5.71° from vertical. This computes known geometry; it does not prove a unique optical inverse solution.
steps.observation: 散射反演需要明確幾何參數化；節距可固定但須有獨立依據。
steps.observationEn: Scatter inversion needs explicit geometry parameterization; Fixing pitch needs independent evidence.
steps.failure: 若採用「不定義形狀便宣稱光譜能直接讀出線寬」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Reading CD directly from spectra without geometry assumptions", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「週期標靶」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：散射反演需要明確幾何參數化。
算例驗收：驗算兩種角度並在截面上標明參考方向，避免將 84.29° 與 5.71° 誤認互相矛盾。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Periodic targets diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Scatter inversion needs explicit geometry parameterization.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify both angles and mark reference directions so 84.29° and 5.71° are not mistaken for contradictory results.
